title: Sean McVay: I don't like it that the Rams are 1-2, but we grow through adversity

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay: I don't like it that the Rams are 1-2, but we grow through adversity
sources.description: "It's a challenge for me: What kind of leader do I want to be for this group?" McVay said.
